root_causes.root_cause: RFC-034 D18 write barrier introduces PersistenceNotVisibleError - a new unhandled exception type in the save_doc/save_doc_meta persistence path. For world-stats-pocketbook (292 pages, ~2M chars tree producing ~5-10MB JSON), MinIO stat_object verification after put_object may exceed the 4-retry backoff window (0.1+0.3+1.0+3.0=4.4s). If raised from save_doc, it propagates as generic Exception through converters_cli, killing the child process. The doc ends up absent because save_doc_meta never executes. In preprocess_client path, error is printed and swallowed (no Redis record). This is a new failure mode introduced by commit 932d634.
root_causes.suggested_fix: 1) Add PersistenceNotVisibleError to converters_cli error classification so it surfaces with a descriptive reason rather than generic converter_child_failed. 2) Scale _WRITE_BARRIER_DELAYS based on object size (e.g. double delays for objects >1MB). 3) Add save_flat_doc write barrier parity (currently missing _confirm_write_visible).

root_causes.root_cause: Pipeline execution order puts world-stats-pocketbook last. The doc sorts alphabetically last (w) among the 25-doc corpus in doc_store/ and is the slowest to convert (292 pages, 24-49 min observed). preprocess_client processes files via sorted() with PREPROCESS_CONCURRENCY=1 (sequential). If the Run 18 ingest pipeline was terminated before completion (manual stop, session timeout, infrastructure failure), this doc would be the one missed. 24/25 docs scored in Run 18, consistent with last-doc-dropped.
root_causes.suggested_fix: Process largest/slowest docs first (sort by file size descending or by historical conversion time) so pipeline truncation drops small docs rather than the largest. Alternatively, add a completion manifest that tracks which docs were submitted vs completed, so absences are immediately attributable.

needs_doc_drilldown.reason: Cannot distinguish between WK-1 (write barrier failure) and WK-2 (pipeline truncation) without worker/preprocess logs from Run 18. Need to check: (1) whether the doc was submitted for processing at all, (2) if submitted, whether it timed out or hit PersistenceNotVisibleError, (3) Redis job status for this doc_id. The doc has a documented history of ERRORing 3 consecutive runs and persistence-timing races across Run 15/16.
